name: Slider
label: Slider
description: Range input for selecting a value between a minimum and maximum, in default and compact sizes.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label text rendered above the slider, which names it. Without one the
slider is named by the native `aria-label`, then the deprecated
`ariaLabel`, and defaults to "Slider" so it is never nameless.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message rendered below the slider

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — recolours the helper text and marks the slider invalid

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the slider required and renders the required marker on its label

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current value opposite the helper line

props.name: value
props.description:
Current value (controlled). Leave it undefined for an uncontrolled
slider, which keeps its own state seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled (`value` undefined). Defaults to 50.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute)

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Convenience callback receiving the numeric value directly.
Fires alongside `onChange`, which keeps the standard React event signature
so form libraries work unmodified.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the <input>
